sources.title: MONTSERRAT IMAGE — scoped primary-place evidence

sources.title: LATIRANA DIOCESE 2025 — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: Contemporary diocesan reporting identifies the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Mount Carmel at La Tirana; July 15, 2025 Mass, first communions, pilgrims and bailes religiosos documented as dated activities, not a permanent schedule.

sources.title: TABGHA PRIMACY — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land

sources.title: JAFFA STPETER — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Acts 9–10 Peter traditions in Jaffa; current Roman Catholic St Peter's church built in 1888–1894, with Franciscan pilgrimage hospitality distinct from apostolic-era walls.

sources.title: NAZARETH ANNUNCIATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Basilica of Annunciation and internally venerated grotto; new church consecrated in 1969 over earlier Byzantine and Crusader remains, without treating grotto tradition as independently proven Gospel coordinates.

sources.title: TABOR TRANSFIGURATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Franciscan Basilica of the Transfiguration built 1921–1924 by Antonio Barluzzi in a Byzantine-era pilgrimage setting; biblical event and traditional mountain identification distinguished.

sources.title: TABGHA MULTIPLICATION — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land (context on neighbouring Benedictine sanctuary)
sources.contribution: The Benedictine Multiplication church at Tabgha contains ancient loaves-and-fishes mosaics; distinct from nearby Franciscan Primacy chapel; traditional associations, not archaeological proof of a miracle.

sources.title: EINKAREM VISITATION — scoped primary-place evidence

sources.title: DOMINUS FLEVIT — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.issuer: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land
sources.contribution: Franciscan Dominus Flevit sanctuary on Mount of Olives, linked by tradition to Luke 19 and overlooking Jerusalem; reference to the commemorative site documented from late thirteenth or early fourteenth century.

sources.title: VILNIUS DIVINE MERCY — scoped primary-place evidence
sources.contribution: Original Divine Mercy image painted by Eugeniusz Kazimirowski following St Faustina's account is housed in the Vilnius Shrine of Divine Mercy; pilgrimage devotion distinguished from other reproductions.

sources.title: QUEZON LOURDES — scoped primary-place evidence

sources.title: Basilika Maria Taferl — taferl construction

sources.title: Kloster Einsiedeln — einsiedeln 2026
